items.en: U.S. Launches New Round of Strikes on Iranian Revolutionary Guard Targets; Oil Closes Above $90 for First Time in a Month
items.zh: 美國再度空襲伊朗革命衛隊目標，油價衝破 90 美元、創一個月新高
items.source: Wikipedia Current Events／Zacks／Alain Guillot Market Recap
items.summary: U.S. forces launched a fresh round of airstrikes on Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps targets on Tuesday, responding to attempted attacks on commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz and on American troops in the region. Two tankers were reportedly hit Monday while leaving the strait. Tehran responded defiantly, threatening to block oil exports through the Gulf if pressure continues. Markets reacted immediately: Brent crude rose 4.6% to $94.65 a barrel and U.S. WTI climbed 5.2% to $90.22, its first close above $90 in more than a month. Because oil feeds into transport, manufacturing and consumer prices, traders quickly reframed the conflict as an inflation problem rather than a purely geopolitical one.

items.en: Germany Blames Russia for Leipzig Airport Drone Plot, Orders Bonn Consulate Closed and Raises Threat Level to High
items.zh: 德國認定俄羅斯策動萊比錫機場無人機攻擊，關閉波昂領事館並將威脅等級調升至「高」
items.summary: Germany's government on Tuesday formally blamed Russia for an attempted attack at Leipzig/Halle Airport on 4 August, in which an explosive-laden drone was found near a Ukrainian aircraft and later defused. Berlin ordered the Russian consulate in Bonn closed effective 18 September and rescinded the contract operating the Russian House cultural centre in Berlin. Germany will also propose adding more Russian individuals to EU sanctions lists over hybrid attacks, tighten entry controls for Russian nationals and increase pressure on the shadow fleet. NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte and European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen both pledged full solidarity with Berlin.

items.en: Norway's King Haakon VIII Swears Oath of Allegiance to the Constitution as His Father Lies in State
items.zh: 挪威新王哈康八世於國會宣誓效忠憲法，父王哈拉德五世仍在停靈
items.summary: Norway's new monarch, King Haakon VIII, 53, swore an oath of allegiance to the constitution before the Storting on Tuesday, days after the death of his father King Harald V at the age of 89 on 28 August. Standing in parliament he declared: I promise and swear that I will govern the kingdom of Norway in accordance with its constitution and laws, so help me God, the almighty and omniscient. Crown Princess Ingrid Alexandra stood at his side, a historic first for a female heir to the Norwegian throne. The new king has adopted the motto All for Norway, inherited from his great-grandfather.

items.en: Israel Says It Captured Senior Hamas Internal Security Official in Gaza Ground Operation; Four Reported Killed
items.zh: 以色列稱在加薩地面行動中擒獲哈瑪斯高階內部安全官員，巴方通報 4 人死亡
items.summary: Palestinian health officials said four people were killed in Israeli strikes during a ground operation in Gaza, while Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu stated that Israeli forces had captured a senior Hamas internal security official during the raid. The operation marks a continuation of intermittent ground activity in the territory despite periodic pauses in fighting, and comes as regional attention is dominated by the separate escalation between the United States and Iran around the Strait of Hormuz. The two conflicts are being watched together by energy traders because either could disrupt shipping and supply routes in the Gulf.

items.en: Markets Now Price Roughly Two-Thirds Odds of a September Fed Rate Hike as 10-Year Yield Hits 4.79%
items.zh: 市場對 Fed 9 月升息押注升到約三分之二，十年期公債殖利率觸及 4.79%
items.summary: The bond market may have mattered more than oil for stocks on Tuesday. The 10-year U.S. Treasury yield climbed to 4.79%, its highest since January 2025, while the 30-year traded near 5.27%. After Fed Chair Kevin Warsh warned at Jackson Hole that inflation remains too high, and with crude surging, traders raised the implied probability of a September rate hike to roughly two-thirds during the session. July JOLTS data showed 7.3 million job openings, little changed, suggesting a labour market stable enough to give the Fed room to tighten. Friday's August employment report, the last before the 15–16 September meeting, is now the week's decisive event.

items.en: SEMICON Taiwan 2026 Opens in Taipei: The Bottleneck for AI Chips Is No Longer the Chip, It Is the Wire Between Them
items.zh: SEMICON Taiwan 2026 台北開展：AI 晶片的瓶頸不再是晶片本身，而是連接它們的線
items.summary: SEMICON Taiwan 2026 opened its International Semiconductor Week forums in Taipei on 31 August, with the main exhibition running from 2 September. The edition is record-setting on every measure: more than 1,300 exhibitors, 4,300 booths, 18 national pavilions and over 100,000 professionals expected from 65 countries. The organising theme is interconnect rather than raw compute. Conference sessions argue the central engineering question is no longer which chip is fastest but whether the wiring between chips can keep up, with co-packaged optics entering commercial production during 2026. For Taiwan-listed suppliers this puts CCL, substrate, optical module and cooling vendors at the centre of the story.

items.en: Dell and Palo Alto Networks Report After Tuesday's Close as Wall Street Looks for AI Spending Beyond Nvidia
items.zh: 戴爾與 Palo Alto 週二盤後公布財報，市場想確認 AI 支出是否擴散到輝達以外
items.summary: Dell Technologies and Palo Alto Networks reported after Tuesday's close, and both were framed as tests of whether the AI buildout is broadening. Dell offers a window into demand for servers used to train and run AI models, while Palo Alto covers cybersecurity, the other fast-growing line of corporate technology spend. The context matters: Nvidia showed last week that demand for AI accelerators remains extraordinary, so investors now want evidence that spending is flowing through the wider ecosystem rather than concentrating in one supplier. Dell shares were down about 5.9% during Tuesday's session ahead of the print.

items.en: U.S. Manufacturing Still Expanding in August but Slowing, With Input Costs Tied to Tariffs and the AI Buildout
items.zh: 美國 8 月製造業仍在擴張但動能放緩，投入成本壓力來自關稅、中東與 AI 基建
items.summary: The Institute for Supply Management reported that U.S. manufacturing remained in expansion territory in August, though growth moderated from July with slower new orders. Manufacturers again flagged higher input prices, attributing them to tariffs, Middle East tensions and the sheer scale of artificial-intelligence infrastructure construction. The combination is awkward for the Federal Reserve: the economy keeps growing while price pressures stay elevated, which weakens the argument that tightening would immediately damage output. For chemical and materials suppliers, the AI buildout is increasingly showing up as demand for power, cooling and specialty materials rather than as electronics demand alone.

items.en: US Open First Round Wraps After Three Days as Gauff, Keys and Fritz Open Their Campaigns on Arthur Ashe
items.zh: 美網第一輪三天賽程結束，高芙、基絲與弗里茨在亞瑟艾許球場開打
items.summary: The first round of the 2026 US Open concluded on Tuesday 1 September after three days of play at Flushing Meadows. Arthur Ashe Stadium carried three American storylines in a single day: Australian Open champion Madison Keys, former finalist Taylor Fritz and 2023 US Open winner Coco Gauff all began their singles campaigns. The draw remains loaded, with Aryna Sabalenka, Elena Rybakina, Jessica Pegula, Carlos Alcaraz and Ben Shelton also through the opening stage. With the first round complete, the tournament now moves into the second round where seeding collisions begin to appear.

items.en: Roland-Garros Champion and Top Seed Alexander Zverev Begins Title Defence at Flushing Meadows
items.zh: 頭號種子、法網冠軍茲維列夫展開美網衛冕之路
items.summary: Reigning Roland-Garros men's singles champion Alexander Zverev, seeded first at the 2026 US Open, opened his campaign at Flushing Meadows during the extended first round. Zverev arrives as the man to beat in the top half of the draw, but the field around him is unusually deep, with Carlos Alcaraz, Ben Shelton and Taylor Fritz all live threats in New York's fast conditions. The men's draw has been notable this year for how few straightforward paths exist to the second week, and the opening three days produced a heavier-than-usual schedule as matches were spread across Ashe, Armstrong and the outer courts.

items.en: Serena and Venus Williams Enter the US Open Doubles Draw Together on a Wild Card
items.zh: 小威與大威以外卡搭檔重返美網女雙賽場
items.summary: Serena and Venus Williams are competing together in the 2026 US Open doubles draw as a wild card entry, a pairing that has drawn outsized attention in New York even against a first round that featured Gauff, Keys, Fritz and Zverev. The sisters won 14 Grand Slam doubles titles together during their careers, and their appearance gives the tournament a marquee attraction outside the singles brackets. For the USTA the entry is also a scheduling asset, guaranteeing a headline evening match that does not depend on how the singles seeds progress through the early rounds.

items.en: Eight-Year Finnish Study Finds Children With More Screen Time Showed Better Cognitive Processing as Teenagers
items.zh: 芬蘭八年追蹤研究：螢幕時間較多的兒童，青少年期認知處理反而較好
items.summary: An eight-year Finnish longitudinal study following children into adolescence found that those who spent more time on screens tended to show better cognitive processing as teenagers, a result that runs against the common assumption that screen exposure uniformly harms developing attention and thinking. Researchers stress the finding is about association rather than proof of benefit, and that what children do on screens is likely to matter more than how many hours they log. The study is a useful corrective for students who feel guilty about screen use, but it does not license unlimited scrolling before exams.

items.en: Paying Students to Sleep Raised Nights of Seven-Plus Hours by 26% and Improved Their Grades
items.zh: 付錢請大學生睡覺：睡滿七小時的夜晚增加 26%，成績也跟著變好
items.summary: A study published in August 2026 tested whether financial incentives could change college sleep behaviour, and found that they could. Incentives increased the share of nights with seven or more hours of sleep by 26%, and added roughly eight minutes of weeknight sleep on average, with measurable improvement in grades following. The result matters less as a policy proposal than as evidence about mechanism: student sleep deprivation appears to be driven substantially by choice and competing incentives rather than by inability to sleep, which suggests structural nudges may work better than advice alone during exam-heavy semesters.

items.en: Both Too Little and Too Much Sleep Linked to Faster Biological Aging, With the Sweet Spot Around 6.4 to 7.8 Hours
items.zh: 睡太少與睡太多都與生理老化加速有關，最佳區間約 6.4 至 7.8 小時
items.summary: Research reported in late August 2026 found a U-shaped relationship between sleep duration and biological ageing across multiple body systems, with the lowest measured ageing among people sleeping roughly 6.4 to 7.8 hours per day. Both short and long sleepers showed faster ageing markers, meaning the common student strategy of compensating for weekday deprivation with very long weekend sleeps may not fully reset the cost. A separate 2026 paper on residential college students found that socially motivated bedtime procrastination shortened sleep and worsened next-day mood and sleepiness.

items.en: Anthropic Ships Shared Memory Across Claude Chat and Cowork, Plus a Built-In Browser in the Desktop App
items.zh: Anthropic 推出跨 Claude 對話與 Cowork 的共享記憶，桌面版內建瀏覽器
items.summary: Anthropic rolled out shared memory across Claude chat and Claude Cowork, so that context carries between conversations and task sessions rather than restarting each time. Users can view, edit, delete, pause or reset stored memories, which addresses the main objection to persistent memory in assistants: that you cannot see or correct what the model believes about you. The company also shipped a built-in browser in the desktop app, letting Claude open websites in a side panel and complete web tasks while the user watches. Anthropic separately published its approach to designing and scaling AI instruction through Claude Academy.

items.en: Google Expands Gemini Line With 3.6 Flash and Omni 1.1, and Launches Gemini Enterprise for Legal
items.zh: Google 擴張 Gemini 產品線：3.6 Flash、Omni 1.1 影音模型，並推出法律業專用的 Gemini Enterprise
items.source: Google Blog／Artificial Lawyer／Google Cloud release notes
items.summary: Google Cloud unveiled Gemini Enterprise for Legal on 25 August, an agentic AI product built specifically for legal industry workflows, joining OpenAI and Anthropic in offering a dedicated legal tier. On the model side, Gemini 3.6 Flash brings better token efficiency and stronger code and agentic planning at a lower price than 3.5 Flash, while Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite targets high-volume automation as a low-latency subagent. Google also introduced Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash for video generation, adding scene extension, first-and-last-frame interpolation and 4K upscaling, now available in Flow, AI Studio and the Gemini app.

items.en: Intel to Launch Crescent Island AI Chip in 2026 as TSMC Moves 2nm Into Production
items.zh: 英特爾 2026 年推 Crescent Island AI 晶片，台積電 2 奈米同步進入量產
items.summary: Intel is preparing to launch Crescent Island, a new AI accelerator aimed at recovering share in AI hardware with an emphasis on energy efficiency and data-centre performance per watt. The competitive backdrop is unforgiving: Nvidia introduced its Vera Rubin superchip at CES 2026 and AMD showed its own AI data-centre system at the same event. Meanwhile TSMC's 2nm generation is entering production, extending the foundry lead that anchors Taiwan's supply chain. Taken together with SEMICON Taiwan's focus on interconnect, the 2026 competitive question is shifting from peak chip performance toward power, packaging and the links between accelerators.

items.en: Fujii Kaze Opens His Prema World Tour in Taiwan: 31 October at Kaohsiung National Stadium, Hong Kong Date Cancelled
items.zh: 藤井風世界巡演首站給了台灣：10/31 高雄世運主場館開唱，香港場已確認取消
items.source: Blow 吹音樂／TVBS／SPICE／音楽ナタリー
items.summary: Fujii Kaze's Prema World Tour, built around his all-English third album Prema, opens its Asian run in Taiwan on 31 October 2026 at Kaohsiung National Stadium, the first stop of the world tour and a step up from his earlier Taipei TICC show. Japanese dates follow at Fukuoka on 14 and 15 November, Osaka on 10, 12 and 13 December and Tokyo on 19 and 20 December, with Bangkok on 26 December at Suphachalasai National Stadium and Seoul at Gocheok Dome on 9 January 2027. The originally announced Hong Kong date has been cancelled, so Hong Kong fans should look at the Kaohsiung or Bangkok stops instead.

items.en: Mrs. GREEN APPLE Confirm Sixth Album for 30 September, With First Arena Tour in Three Years Running to December
items.zh: Mrs. GREEN APPLE 第六張原創專輯 9/30 發行，三年來首次巡迴自 9 月底跑到 12 月
items.summary: Mrs. GREEN APPLE will release their sixth original full-length album on 30 September 2026, their first since this year's stadium run, and follow it immediately with their first arena tour in three years. Dates span late September through December across Kagawa, Hiroshima, Chiba, Hokkaido, Tokyo, Saga, Fukui, Nagano and Hyogo. Their earlier ZENJIN MITO TO IM/MUTABLE stadium tour, which opened in April 2026 at Japan National Stadium and Yanmar Stadium Nagai, drew a combined 390,000 people with live viewings staged in Taiwan, Hong Kong, South Korea and Thailand. Taiwanese fans should watch for a live-viewing announcement rather than a local date.

items.en: YOASOBI Announce Asia 10-City Dome and Stadium Tour 2026-2027, a First for a Japanese Act
items.zh: YOASOBI 宣布亞洲十城巨蛋體育場巡迴 2026-2027，日本藝人首例
items.summary: YOASOBI announced the YOASOBI ASIA 10-CITY DOME & STADIUM TOUR 2026-2027, making them the first Japanese act to attempt an Asia-wide top-ten dome and stadium run. The scale marks a shift for a duo that broke through on streaming rather than through traditional arena progression, and Asian markets including Taiwan have historically been among their strongest outside Japan. Before the tour proper, YOASOBI are scheduled to perform at BlizzCon 2026 in Anaheim, California on 13 September and at the Grammy Museum in Los Angeles on 14 September, continuing their push into North American appearances.

items.en: 2026 Is Shaping Up as a Record Year for Large-Scale Japanese Live Shows, With Vaundy, Ado and back number All Scaling Up
items.zh: 2026 成為日本大型公演爆發年，Vaundy、Ado、back number 同步升級場館規模
items.source: リアルサウンド／Yahoo!ニュース
items.summary: Japanese music media are describing 2026 as an acceleration year for large-scale live performance, with Fujii Kaze, Vaundy, Ado, YOASOBI, back number and SUPER BEAVER all moving into dome, stadium or expanded arena configurations within the same twelve months. The pattern reflects a post-pandemic normalisation of very large venues combined with streaming-era artists finally converting global listener bases into physical attendance. For fans in Taiwan and Hong Kong the practical consequence is that Asian legs and live viewings are now planned into tours from the start rather than added afterwards, so ticket windows open earlier and sell out faster.

market.highlight: 🔭 今天到週五要盯的三件事：　① 【週五 8 月非農是這週的分水嶺】這是 Fed 9/15–16 會議前最後一份月度就業報告。反直覺的地方在於：報告太強不一定是好消息——強就業＋貴油價＋黏著通膨，反而讓 Fed 有底氣升息；報告太弱則變成「成長轉差但通膨還在」。兩邊都不舒服，所以週五盤前不要重押方向。　② 【台股 47,000 點與外資買盤能不能延續】9/1 收在 46,948.72，距 47,000 只剩 51 點，且是收最高、量能重回兆元、三大法人同買。但美股 9/1 是收黑的，台股今天（9/2）開盤要先消化這個落差。真正的觀察點不是有沒有站上 47K，而是外資 267 億的買超是「SEMICON 展期的短打」還是「連續性的加碼」。　③ 【油價是這整條因果鏈的源頭】WTI 收在 90.22、布蘭特 94.65，如果荷莫茲海峽的衝突再升一級、油價往 100 美元靠，升息機率會再往上，先受傷的會是量子（IONQ、RGTI、QBTS、QUBT）、加密（COIN、MSTR、CRCL、HOOD）與太空（RKLB、ASTS）這幾類高 beta、無獲利支撐的族群——你的觀察清單裡這三塊佔比不低，值得先想好停損。
